svg.text: Morgan's white-eyed Drosophila: an X-linked gene
1. P: red female x white male
Morgan's F2 count (book): 3473 red-eyed (males and females), 782 white-eyed (all males)
his testcross (F1 red female x white male) gave red and white females and males 1 : 1 : 1 : 1:
white-eyed females can exist, so the gene must be on the X chromosome (none on the Y)

text.tspan: = X with white allele, Y carries no eye-colour allele

svg.text: the book's numbers add to 4255, not the 4252 it prints; 782 is about 18% of either total
eye colour shown: red (filled) or white (empty); female abdomen striped, male tip dark
Original diagram for this lesson; the textbook's picture is not reproduced.
